comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: I have taken this quest more than once, so it is certainly repeatable. I believe all job quests are, except perhaps for the level 76 classes of Great Adventurer, Millionaire, and Grand Admiral. (Or am I mistaken on that point?) That said, I do not believe the prequest can be repeated, however, as I've not seen it since completion.
